groups.operation: Return from the add-string parse-error branch after ucl_parser_add_string_priority.
groups.condition: The entry reports a parse error.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns error-path cleanup, not comment setup or comment ownership.

groups.operation: Parse a string with saved-comment behavior enabled.
groups.condition: Input contains comments that the parser supports saving.
groups.capability: Configure UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS and reach comment collection and attachment.
groups.consequence: Saved-comment behavior cannot be exercised through the entry.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns configuration and reachability, not cleanup of an existing comment.

groups.operation: Finish parsing or free a parser that holds an orphan parser->last_comment.
groups.condition: A saved comment remains in parser->last_comment without an owner.
groups.capability: Release parser->last_comment exactly once and clear its pointer when released.
groups.consequence: The orphan comment may remain allocated or be released again.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns ownership of parser->last_comment after it exists, distinct from enabling saved comments.
